Limits: the participant was not permitted to read `grill-with-docs`, so where
plan-work would compose it for the ADR-007 decision it posed the questions
directly and reported the gap. It flagged a tension outside this checkpoint:
the Claude Code adapter's bug-fix-from-report clause recommends Opus/high for
a one-string typo fix whose ratings alone suggest low. That belongs to

These are bounded simulated decisions from one context. They do not establish
native skill discovery, host behavior, tracker execution or behavior in real
external projects.
